Trigger: Any GCP SetIamPolicy call (self-granted security-admin role / owner role to external identity / audit-config removal all reduce to this same event given confirmed CIM data — see note) NOTE: COLLAPSED from 3 near-duplicate rows (this scenario, T1098.001 'Owner Role Granted to External Gmail', and T1562.001 'Audit Logging Disabled') — none of the 3 could isolate the actual policy-delta content from confirmed CIM data, so all 3 reduced to the identical bare condition 'a SetIamPolicy call happened'. Kept as one broad rule rather than 3 rules that fire identically and indistinguishably on ANY IAM policy change, including benign ones. Recommend re-splitting once a production sample with the request.policy delta field is available.
